LanguageData.MSSFP_GRF_Settings_Blurb: Colonists treat graffiti as a mess and will scrub it off once it is inside the home area. Turn this on to make painted graffiti stay where it was painted.
LanguageData.MSSFP_GRF_Settings_PermanentTip: Colonists will no longer take jobs to clean graffiti off. Deconstructing it, or building or smoothing over the surface, still removes it. A cleaning job already underway will finish.
